# Protein vs Metabolite
```{r}
load("Data/Protein.rda")
load("Data/Metabolomic.rda")

# Data transformation
dat_X <- Protein
dat_Y <- Metabolomic
rm(Protein, Metabolomic)

n <- dat_X$n # Sample size
p_X <- dat_X$p # Dimension for the first dataset
p_Y <- dat_Y$p # Dimension for the second dataset

## Estimation
grid_num <- 201 # Number of evaluated time points for functions
time_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = grid_num)
max_var <- floor(c(min(p_X / 2, n), min(p_Y / 2, n)))

Result <- CCVA(grid_num = grid_num,      # Number of evaluated time points for functional objects
               dat_X, dat_Y,             # Two high-dimensional longitudinal datasets
               max_var = max_var,        # Maximum number of selected features
               length_tun = 30,          # Number of evaluated tuning parameters for two datasets
               print_tuning = F,         # Do we print the tuning result?
               comp = 1,                 # How many components we estimate?
               FVE = 0.95,               # Fraction of variance explained for basis function estimation
               Sparse = T)               # Do we apply sparse estimation?

save(Result, file = "Result/fit_Protein_Metabolomic.rda", version = 2)
```

# Correlation
```{r}
file_name <- c("fit_Protein_Metabolomic.rda", "fit_Protein_Lipid.rda",
               "fit_Metabolomic_Lipid.rda")

var_name <- cbind(var1 = c("Protein", "Protein", "Metabolite"),
                  var2 = c("Metabolite", "Lipid", "Lipid"))

dat_plot <- data_frame()
cor <- vector()
for(i in 1:3){
  load(paste0("Result/", file_name[i]))
  X_cca <- Result$Z_X[[1]]
  Y_cca <- Result$Z_Y[[1]]
  cor[i] <- abs(crossprod(X_cca, Y_cca) / sqrt(crossprod(X_cca, X_cca) * crossprod(Y_cca, Y_cca)))
  dat_plot <- rbind(dat_plot, 
                    data.frame(
                      X = X_cca, Y = Y_cca,
                      cor = c(cor[i], rep(NA, n - 1)), var1 = rep(var_name[i,1], n), var2 = rep(var_name[i,2], n),
                      text_x = c(min(X_cca), rep(NA, n - 1)), text_y = c(max(Y_cca) + 0.2, rep(NA, n - 1))
                    ))
 
}

dat_plot$var1 <- factor(dat_plot$var1, levels = c("Protein", "Metabolite", "Lipid"))
dat_plot$var2 <- factor(dat_plot$var2, levels = c("Protein", "Metabolite", "Lipid"))

ggplot(dat_plot) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = X, y = Y)) +  
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(x = text_x, y = text_y, label = paste0("Correlation ", round(cor, 3))), size = 4, max.overlaps = 100) +
  facet_wrap(~ var1 + var2, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw(base_family = "Times") +
  xlab("The first dataset") + ylab("The second dataset") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        text = element_text(size = 15),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        # text = element_text(family = "STHeiti"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))

# ggsave("Figure/score.pdf", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 100)
```



# Important variables
```{r}
load("Data/Protein.rda")
load("Data/Metabolomic.rda")
load("Data/Lipid.rda")
time_label <- c('Baseline', "2 min", "15 min", "30 min", "60 min")
hight_feature <- 10

# Protein vs Metabolite
load(paste0("Result/", file_name[1]))
p1 <- plot_CCVA(Result, Protein, Metabolomic, 
                 hight_feature, # The number of important features you want to highlight
                 k = 1, " Protein", "Metabolite", (0:4)/4, time_label, "(A)")

# CSV output
feature_list <- list(feature_X = p1$feature_X, feature_Y = p1$feature_Y)
max_len <- max(length(feature_list$feature_X), length(feature_list$feature_Y))
feature_df <- data.frame(
  "Protein" = c(feature_list$feature_X, rep(NA, max_len - length(feature_list$feature_X))),
  "Metabolite" = c(feature_list$feature_Y, rep(NA, max_len - length(feature_list$feature_Y)))
)

write.csv(feature_df, "Result/Protein_Metabolite_features_output.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Protein vs Lipid
load(paste0("Result/", file_name[2]))
p2 <- plot_CCVA(Result, Protein, Lipid, 
                 hight_feature, # The number of important features you want to highlight
                 k = 1, " Protein", "Lipid", (0:4)/4, time_label, "(B)")

# CSV output
feature_list <- list(feature_X = p2$feature_X, feature_Y = p2$feature_Y)
max_len <- max(length(feature_list$feature_X), length(feature_list$feature_Y))
feature_df <- data.frame(
  "Protein" = c(feature_list$feature_X, rep(NA, max_len - length(feature_list$feature_X))),
  "Lipid" = c(feature_list$feature_Y, rep(NA, max_len - length(feature_list$feature_Y)))
)

write.csv(feature_df, "Result/Protein_Lipid_features_output.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Metabolite vs Lipid
load(paste0("Result/", file_name[3]))
p3 <- plot_CCVA(Result, Metabolomic, Lipid, 
                 hight_feature, # The number of important features you want to highlight
                 k = 1, " Metabolite", "Lipid", 0:4/ 4, time_label, "(C)")

# CSV output
feature_list <- list(feature_X = p3$feature_X, feature_Y = p3$feature_Y)
max_len <- max(length(feature_list$feature_X), length(feature_list$feature_Y))
feature_df <- data.frame(
  "Metabolite" = c(feature_list$feature_X, rep(NA, max_len - length(feature_list$feature_X))),
  "Lipid" = c(feature_list$feature_Y, rep(NA, max_len - length(feature_list$feature_Y)))
)

write.csv(feature_df, "Result/Metabolite_Lipid_features_output.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Combined figure
library(cowplot)
p_all <- plot_grid(p1$plot, p2$plot, p3$plot,
                   ncol = 1, align = "v")
ggsave("Figure/functional_loading.pdf", p_all, width = 15, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

# Network Plot
```{r}
## Loading dataset
dat_name <- factor(c("Protein", "Metabolite", "Lipid"), level = c("Protein", "Metabolite", "Lipid"))
nodes <- unique(c(p1$feature_X, p1$feature_Y, p2$feature_X, p2$feature_Y, p3$feature_X, p3$feature_Y))
group <- sapply(1:length(nodes), function(l) dat_name[which(c(sum(Protein$feature_label == nodes[l]),
       sum(Metabolomic$feature_label == nodes[l]),
       sum(Lipid$feature_label == nodes[l])) == 1)])

## Edge matrix
Edge <- matrix(0, length(nodes), length(nodes))
# Edge_boot <- array(0, c(length(nodes), length(nodes), 1001))

load(paste0("Result/", file_name[1]))
mark_X <- p1$feature_X
mark_Y <- p1$feature_Y
for(e in 1:length(mark_X)){
  for(s in 1:length(mark_Y)){
    Edge[which(nodes == mark_X[e]), which(nodes == mark_Y[s])] <-
      abs(crossprod(Result$load_X[[1]][Result$var_X[[1]][e],], Result$load_Y[[1]][Result$var_Y[[1]][s],]) /
      sqrt(crossprod(Result$load_X[[1]][Result$var_X[[1]][e],], Result$load_X[[1]][Result$var_X[[1]][e],]) * crossprod(Result$load_Y[[1]][Result$var_Y[[1]][s],], Result$load_Y[[1]][Result$var_Y[[1]][s],]))) * cor[1]
  }
}

load(paste0("Result/", file_name[2]))
mark_X <- p2$feature_X
mark_Y <- p2$feature_Y
for(e in 1:length(mark_X)){
  for(s in 1:length(mark_Y)){
    Edge[which(nodes == mark_X[e]), which(nodes == mark_Y[s])] <-
      abs(crossprod(Result$load_X[[1]][Result$var_X[[1]][e],], Result$load_Y[[1]][Result$var_Y[[1]][s],]) /
      sqrt(crossprod(Result$load_X[[1]][Result$var_X[[1]][e],], Result$load_X[[1]][Result$var_X[[1]][e],]) * crossprod(Result$load_Y[[1]][Result$var_Y[[1]][s],], Result$load_Y[[1]][Result$var_Y[[1]][s],]))) * cor[2]
  }
}  

load(paste0("Result/", file_name[3]))
mark_X <- p3$feature_X
mark_Y <- p3$feature_Y
for(e in 1:length(mark_X)){
  for(s in 1:length(mark_Y)){
    Edge[which(nodes == mark_X[e]), which(nodes == mark_Y[s])] <-
      abs(crossprod(Result$load_X[[1]][Result$var_X[[1]][e],], Result$load_Y[[1]][Result$var_Y[[1]][s],]) /
      sqrt(crossprod(Result$load_X[[1]][Result$var_X[[1]][e],], Result$load_X[[1]][Result$var_X[[1]][e],]) * crossprod(Result$load_Y[[1]][Result$var_Y[[1]][s],], Result$load_Y[[1]][Result$var_Y[[1]][s],]))) * cor[3]
  }
}


Edge <- Edge + t(Edge)
# Edge[Edge <= 0.5] <- 0

adj_matrix <- Edge[which(colSums(Edge > 0) > 0), which(colSums(Edge > 0) > 0)]
node_name <- nodes[which(colSums(Edge > 0) > 0)]
group <- group[which(colSums(Edge > 0) > 0)]

highlight_name <- c((node_name[group == "Protein"])[order(colSums(adj_matrix)[group == "Protein"], decreasing = T)[1:10]],  (node_name[group == "Metabolite"])[order(colSums(adj_matrix)[group == "Metabolite"], decreasing = T)[1:10]], (node_name[group == "Lipid"])[order(colSums(adj_matrix)[group == "Lipid"], decreasing = T)[1:10]])

node_name <- sapply(1:length(node_name), function(l){
  mark <- sum(sapply(1:length(highlight_name), function(h){
    node_name[l] == highlight_name[h]
  }))
  if(mark == 1){
    node_name[l]
  }else{
    NA
  }
})


g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_matrix, mode = "undirected", weighted = T)
V(g)$group <- group
layout <- layout_with_fr(g)

# Plot using a force-directed layout
get_legend <- function(mygg) {
  gg <- ggplotGrob(mygg)
  idx <- which(sapply(gg$grobs, function(x) x$name) == "guide-box")
  gg$grobs[[idx]]
}

weight_vals <- seq(min(E(g)$weight), max(E(g)$weight), length.out = 5)
df_leg <- data.frame(x = 1:5,
                     y = 1:5,
                     weight = weight_vals)

p_edge_leg <- ggplot(df_leg, aes(x = x, y = y, color = weight)) +
  geom_point(size = 5, alpha = 0) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low  = "white",
    high = "#2b8cbe",
    name = "Corr",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(3, "cm"),
                           barwidth  = unit(0.4, "cm"))
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 10)
  )

leg_edge <- get_legend(p_edge_leg)
V(g)$deg <- degree(g)

coords <- layout_with_fr(g,
                         niter      = 2e3,
                         area       = vcount(g)^2 * 4,
                         repulserad = vcount(g)^3 * 1.5)

p_main <- ggraph(g,
       layout = "manual",
       x      = coords[,1],
       y      = coords[,2]
)  +
  geom_edge_link(aes(color = weight),
                 alpha       = 0.5,
                 show.legend = T) +
  scale_edge_color_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2b8cbe", guide = FALSE) +
  # scale_edge_color_gradient(guide = FALSE) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = group,
                      size  = deg),     # ← map size to degree
                  alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 4)) + 
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("#b2182b", "#d95f0e", "#006837"),
    name   = ""
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = node_name, color = group),
    show.legend  = FALSE,
    size         = 2,
    force        = 5,
    max.overlaps = 10
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = NULL) +
  theme_void() +
  guides(size = "none") +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "top",   
    text               = element_text(size = 15),
    plot.title         = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )



grid::grid.newpage()
p <- gridExtra::grid.arrange(
  p_main,     
   leg_edge,    
  ncol   = 2,
  widths = c(1.5, 0.2)  
)

ggsave(paste0("Figure/", "association", ".pdf"), p, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
